items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: In the audience that night I remember was Preston Foster...no, Robert Preston, that's the one

ctx.x: And I'll never forget. We were back near the bathroom, talking, and he was saying how he really regretted pawning the saxophone that he had with the Eckstine band when they were playing at the Club Riviera in St. Louis. He said he got his best sound on that horn. He really regretted losing that instrument.

Anyway, everybody was planning for the big night at Jack's Basket Room after-hours. And Leroy had fixed him a big steak and everything, and he was already feelin' good -- he had fresh clothes and everything, heh-heh. And when we got to Jack's Basket Room, the place was loaded. Everybody was waiting on Charlie Parker. In the audience that night I remember was Preston Foster...no, Robert Preston, that's the one, and Ava Gardner and Turon(?) Bey(?), and all kind of musicians and celebrities. Stan Kenton's band was…
This first set that he played on was with Jimmy Bunn on piano; Jo Jones, Daddy Jo The Drummer, on drums; and Curtis Counce I think was playing the bass; and June Christy
